audit.whatIsWrong: The chart said Akshan owns Levels 1-3 and the rest is Skill. Its own why lines say the opposite: whys[1] 'you own this overstep window before his swing comes online', whys[5] 'out-grinds a sustain-less Akshan', whys[6] 'your damage out-scales his fragile body'.
audit.why: Packet chart reads Lillia/Lillia/Skill/Akshan/Akshan/Lillia/Lillia and every why line matches it exactly. Levels 1-3 are your window because Heroic Swing is not online; 4-6 are his because it is.
audit.corrected: Both layers moved to the packet chart in matched pairs with ratings 7 for your rows, 5 for the Skill row, 3 for his.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer sold Level 6 as your spike and first item as a generic Liandry's spike, while the content layer correctly puts Akshan's spike at 4-5 and yours at first item.
audit.why: Heroic Swing (18/16.5/15/13.5/12s) is what turns the lane at 4-5. Your Liandry's percent-HP burn is the real turn back, because Akshan has no sustain in his kit to heal it off.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why and phases[4].why now state his spike with the 18s number; phases[5].why states yours as the no-sustain grind.
sources: enemyKit full list — no heal anywhere

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: the page never names Avengerang, Going Rogue, Dirty Fighting or Comeuppance, and it misses that Swirlseed reveals his camouflage.
audit.why: Going Rogue is camouflage, and Swirlseed carries revealsStealth — rolling it through the brush he vanished into is the answer, which the mirror also recorded from Akshan's side.
audit.corrected: Avengerang and Heroic Swing named in the level-chart whys; the Going Rogue reveal is now on wants.you[1]. NOTE: Dirty Fighting shields him every third hit, so a trade he wins the auto-count on costs you more than the DoT maths suggests.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Heroic Swing a fifteen-second cooldown.
audit.why: It is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12 — eighteen seconds in the levels where the advice matters.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: He has no Heroic Swing yet — farm on the Q edge, deny his Avengerang last-hits, and set the wave.

edits.before: W sweetspot threat starts — anyone chasing you eats the big hit while your Dream Dust burns their HP bar.
edits.after: Q sweetspot plus the Swirlseed slow stacks Dream Dust while his swing is still offline — own this window.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-kite in circles, E from fog for the slow, and the passive speed makes every trade yours to end.
edits.after: Even — your burn and kite are real, but Avengerang returning on the way back makes the trade a wash.

edits.before: The lane is a treadmill he can't get off — Q every step-up, kite the Heroic Swing window, and bank Dream Dust burn.
edits.after: Heroic Swing, 18s at rank 1, gives him the range to dodge your short hops and chip you from outside the sweetspot.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: Full Avengerang poke out-ranges you and your delayed sleep is easy to swing out of — he edges the all-in.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Liandry's turns W and Dream Dust into percent-HP damage a sustain-less Akshan has no way to heal back off.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Sleep a Dream-Dust-marked Akshan into the W wake-hit and his fragile frame simply deletes.

edits.before: Akshan burns Heroic Swing on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Akshan burns Heroic Swing on nothing — it is 18s at rank 1, so go now.

edits.before: Land E Swirlseed to slow his E grapple swing and stick the burn before he kites out
edits.after: Roll Swirlseed through brush — it reveals Going Rogue camo and slows Heroic Swing.

notes: Only 6 recorded games at Emerald+ in the packet (the brief's top-level games field says 21); the 33.33% figure carries no weight and nothing written depends on it. The full layer is still generic boilerplate — tldr and report[0] call this a poke lane you 'jog through' and the whole page uses he/his for both champions; I fixed the chart, its whys and the wrong cooldown, and flag the rest for a pronoun and voice pass rather than half-rewriting it under the length band.
